_comment: First-class registry of every external system Blinker integrates with, plus the per-org configurable fields each one exposes. Replaces the legacy `payment_services` JSONB blob (BlinkerLegacy/blinker/app/models/configuration.rb:200-360) where credentials for Ensurety / FluidPay / FloPay / etc. were nested under opaque keys with test/live splits scattered across env vars. Source for the admin-console Integrations card grid (mission-control/src/personas/admin/Integrations.jsx). Each org's enabled providers + actual credential values live on the org record (org-registry.json `integrations` block); this file defines the SHAPE.
_principle: One block per provider. Each provider declares: identity (id/label/category), what it does (purpose), whether it respects the org-level test_mode broad-switch (per architecture/10-admin-console.md), and the field schema the admin-console Edit drawer renders. Sensitive fields are masked in the UI by default and require an explicit reveal click; reveals are audit-logged.
_test_mode_principle: Per legacy 04-organization-configuration.md, a single per-org `test_mode` boolean flips EVERY integration that supports_test_mode=true to its sandbox endpoint and credential set in one switch. Preserve this fan-out. The admin-console MUST surface a banner on every screen of an org with test_mode enabled, and toggling test_mode requires a confirm-modal listing every provider that will flip. Providers with supports_test_mode=false (e.g., S3, Google Places) are environment-agnostic.
_credential_storage_principle: Phase 1 (now): credential values live in org-registry.json `integrations.<provider_id>.credentials.{test|live}` as plain fixture values (NOT real secrets). Phase 2 (real backend): the API layer stores credentials encrypted-at-rest server-side; the admin-console NEVER receives raw credential values for sensitive fields except via an explicit reveal endpoint. Reveal is gated on `view_integration_credentials` permission (super_admin only by default) and audit-logged.

_categories.crm: Lead + opportunity sync (GoHighLevel today; future Salesforce / HubSpot)
_categories.product_admin: VSC / GAP / appearance product catalog + contract booking (StoneEagle, Express Aftermarket / Omega)
_categories.data: VIN decode (VinAudit), market value (MarketCheck), address autocomplete (Google Places)

ghl.label: GoHighLevel
ghl.purpose: Bi-directional contact + opportunity sync. Per architecture/07-data-layer.md, GHL is a downstream sync target (not source-of-truth); tags are the only bi-directional field.

fields.label: Location ID
fields.help: GHL sub-account location id (e.g., reWBjJ4bl9eIFdUlpl4w for Apex). Visible in the GHL URL when browsing the org's location.

fields.label: API key
fields.help: GHL location-scoped API key. Generate from GHL Settings → Business Profile → API Key.

fields.label: Private integration token
fields.help: v2 PIT for the marketplace app. Required for v2 endpoints.

fields.label: Webhook secret
fields.help: HMAC secret for verifying inbound webhooks (lead-feed, status updates).

fields.label: Pipeline mappings
fields.help: Per-workflow GHL pipeline + stage → platform status. Edited via super-admin StatusMappingEditor (already shipped Wave 13).

fields.label: Custom field mappings
fields.help: Per-org override of canon ghl-fields.json projection. Defaults inherit.

fluidpay.label: FluidPay
fluidpay.purpose: Card tokenization (hosted fields) + charge execution. Used by protection-portal BillingPayment.
fluidpay.test_mode_fanout: URL flips ENV[FLUIDPAY_URL] → ENV[FLUIDPAY_TEST_URL] (sandbox.fluidpay.com); api_key flips fluidpay_live_api_key → fluidpay_test_api_key (legacy configuration.rb:200-208).

fields.label: Public key (tokenizer)
fields.help: Used by FluidPayHostedFields.jsx to initialize the tokenizer iframe.

fields.label: Tokenizer URL
fields.help: Override only when not using FluidPay's default sandbox/live URLs.

ensurety.label: Ensurety
ensurety.purpose: Recurring payment-plan creation + management. The plan provider for monthly-pay protection plans.
ensurety.test_mode_fanout: appId flips ENV[ENSURETY_APP_ID] → ENV[ENSURETY_TEST_APP_ID] (BLINKERTESTAPP). account_code, processor, efs_token all flip live → test (legacy configuration.rb:225-355). EnsuretyClient appends ?testMode=true|false to every API call URL.

fields.label: Processor
fields.help: Processor identifier (e.g., 'fluidpay', 'authnet').

fields.label: EFS token
fields.help: Token for the Ensurety EFS payment endpoint.

fields.label: Default term (months)
fields.help: Default term displayed in protection-portal coverage card $X/mo tooltips. Falls back to org protection_billing.payment_term.default_months when null.

fields.label: Down payment mode
fields.help: How the default down-payment is computed for the $X/mo tooltip on coverage cards. 'same_as_monthly' uses the monthly amount as the down payment; 'percent_of_price' uses down_payment_value as a % of plan price; 'fixed_dollars' uses down_payment_value as a literal $ amount.

fields.label: Down payment value
fields.help: Numeric value used by down_payment_mode. For percent_of_price: 10 = 10%. For fixed_dollars: 500 = $500. Ignored when mode is same_as_monthly.

flopay.label: FloPay
flopay.purpose: Hosted payment-link generation. selected_product.sync_to_flopay is called inside ProductPackages::Create#call (legacy product_packages/create.rb).
flopay.test_mode_fanout: Env-var prefix flips ENV[FLOPAY_*] → ENV[FLOPAY_TEST_*] (legacy flopay_paylink/helper.rb:12).

fields.label: Default term (months)
fields.help: Default term displayed in protection-portal coverage card $X/mo tooltips. Falls back to org protection_billing.payment_term.default_months when null.

fields.label: Down payment mode
fields.help: How the default down-payment is computed for the $X/mo tooltip on coverage cards. 'same_as_monthly' uses the monthly amount as the down payment; 'percent_of_price' uses down_payment_value as a % of plan price; 'fixed_dollars' uses down_payment_value as a literal $ amount.

fields.label: Down payment value
fields.help: Numeric value used by down_payment_mode. For percent_of_price: 10 = 10%. For fixed_dollars: 500 = $500. Ignored when mode is same_as_monthly.

stoneeagle.label: StoneEagle (SCS Auto)
stoneeagle.purpose: VSC product catalog + rate quotes via GetRates SOAP service (architecture/13-stoneeagle-integration.md). Per-org product administrator credentials (TpaCode + UserId + Password + DealerNo). Reference specs at architecture/integration-partners/stoneeagle/.
stoneeagle.test_mode_fanout: Entire credential set flips ENV[STONE_EAGLE_*] → ENV[STONE_EAGLE_TEST_*] including URL (legacy stone_eagle_client.rb:17). The rewrite exposes ALL StoneEagle credentials at the per-org level (web_service_base_url, tpa_code, user_id, password, dealer_no, recipient_id, products_filter).

endpoint_paths._comment: Two ASMX paths derived from web_service_base_url; not per-org configurable (protocol-defined).

fields.label: Web service base URL
fields.help: Base URL with trailing slash (e.g., http://www.natinc.com/SCSAutoService/). Rating + contracting paths are appended in code.

fields.label: TPA code
fields.help: Third-party administrator code (3-4 chars, e.g., OMGA, APEX). THE primary per-org identifier in StoneEagle.

fields.label: Dealer number
fields.help: Unique dealer identifier within the TPA (assigned by SEFI when the dealer is provisioned).

fields.label: Recipient ID
fields.help: Optional integration-partner identifier (per spec v1.30+). Some providers require it for routing.

fields.label: Product codes filter
fields.help: Whitelist of Product Type Codes to expose to this org (per v1.31 spec §ProductCollection). Empty = all 12 codes returned by StoneEagle. Providers may extend with custom codes; canon enumerates the 12 standard codes.

express_aftermarket.label: Express Aftermarket / Omega
express_aftermarket.purpose: Alternative VSC + only-source GAP product administrator. F&I Express system fronting Omega Auto Care. REST/JSON, HTTP Basic auth.
express_aftermarket.test_mode_fanout: Legacy has no separate test mode for Express Aftermarket — confirm with provider before exposing.

fields.label: API URL
fields.help: Defaults to ENV[EXPRESS_AFTERMARKET_API_URL].

fields.label: EX1 Provider ID
fields.help: Omega = 177.

fields.label: Enabled products
fields.help: Array of { product_code, label, margin } — lifts the legacy EXPRESS_AFTERMARKET_PRODUCTS env-var JSON into per-org config (legacy 06-product-services-providers.md flagged this as a rewrite target). Codes: 1525 Appearance, 1526 GAP, 1527 Loyalty Reward, 1528 VSC, 1529 Prepaid Maintenance.

fields.label: States with GAP for refi
fields.help: Lifts ENV[STATES_WITH_GAP_FOR_REFI] into per-org config; deconflicted with system.refi_active_states.

fields.label: States with VSC for refi
fields.help: Lifts ENV[STATES_WITH_VSC_FOR_REFI] into per-org config.

embedded_insurance.label: Embedded Insurance
embedded_insurance.purpose: Insurance quote + verification + bind. The insurance provider for the cross-sell flow. See architecture/06-embedded-insurance-contract.md.
embedded_insurance.test_mode_fanout: Test/live env split per legacy embedded_insurance_client.rb:11.

docuseal.label: DocuSeal
docuseal.purpose: E-signature for protection-package agreements. Embedded as iframe in a Blinker-rendered public page; webhook posts to api/v3/webhooks/docuseal_controller with X-Webhook-Token.
docuseal.test_mode_fanout: No separate test instance configured in legacy — note in the UI.

fields.label: Webhook token
fields.help: X-Webhook-Token header verified on inbound.

fields.label: State-specific template overrides
fields.help: Array of { state, template_id }. UWP-style state-specific templates per legacy screens/12.

twilio.label: Twilio
twilio.purpose: SMS — capture-link delivery, customer-portal handoff notifications, agent-to-customer messaging.
twilio.test_mode_fanout: Different routing / from-number / sandbox behavior (legacy twilio.rb:10).

fields.label: Messaging service SID
fields.help: Optional — overrides from_number when set.

fields.label: Daily SMS fail limit
fields.help: Mirrors legacy configuration.sms_daily_fail_limit. Auto-pause SMS when exceeded.

mandrill.label: Mandrill
mandrill.purpose: Transactional email — capture-link delivery, payment receipts, contract notifications.

zendesk.label: Zendesk
zendesk.purpose: Support ticketing. Agents create tickets from /users/:id/create-ticket per legacy.

fields.label: Subdomain
fields.help: <subdomain>.zendesk.com

plaid.label: Plaid
plaid.purpose: Bank-account linking for ACH down-payments + refi-flow income/asset verification.
plaid.test_mode_fanout: client_id constant; secret + env (sandbox / development / production) flips.

vinaudit.label: VinAudit
vinaudit.purpose: VIN decode for vehicle YMMT. Read-only.

fields.label: API key
fields.help: Browser-restricted by domain in Google Cloud Console.

s3_storage.label: S3 storage
s3_storage.purpose: Org logo + authorized-seller signature image storage. Used by call-center-logo + agreement-signing flows.
